models_evaluated: Custom Presidio recognizers with mod-11 checksum validation

links.outcome: PII detection F1 for de-identification of Brazilian clinical notes by method
links.effect: Custom Presidio macro F1 = 1.000 (n=500); default Presidio 0.270; Llama 3.3 0.989 (n=100). Default tools miss Brazilian identifiers, leaving re-identification risk unless customized.
links.quote: Custom Presidio achieves macro F1 = 1.000 across all seven PII types (n = 500), versus 0.270 for default Presidio and 0.989 for Llama 3.3 (n = 100, rate-limited).

unlisted_practices: Locale-specific PII recognizers with mod-11 checksum validation for CPF and CNPJ
Rule-based deterministic de-identification preferred over LLMs for latency and verification at scale
Open-source release of recognizers and synthetic corpus for Brazilian clinical PII

screen.reason: Evaluates and benchmarks specific deployment safeguard methods (custom PII recognizers with checksum validation vs. LLM zero-shot vs. default tools) for de-identifying clinical text before AI deployment.

primary.practice: automated de-identification / PII scrubbing with checksum validation
